rules.title: Orphaned holds
rules.summary: {{ $values.A }} card hold(s) at the payment provider have no live bid behind them (invariant 4).

rules.title: Outbox failures
rules.summary: {{ $values.A }} outbox row(s) gave up: a cancel, capture or publish that will not be retried.

rules.title: Capture failure
rules.expr: (max by (job) (holdfast_outbox_failed{kind="capture"}) or on() vector(0)) + (max by (job) (holdfast_auctions_unsettled) or on() vector(0))
rules.summary: A winner's hold was not captured: a failed capture, or an auction closed over 10 minutes ago and still not settled.
